reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
name: Knosp Classification (modified) of Cavernous Sinus Invasion

version.label: Knosp classification as modified by Micko et al. (2015): 0, 1, 2, 3A, 3B, 4
version.detail: Based on coronal MRI lines (medial tangent, intercarotid line, lateral tangent) of the intracavernous and supraclinoid ICA. The original 1993 grade 3 is subdivided into 3A and 3B.

purpose: Grades the likelihood of cavernous sinus invasion by pituitary adenoma.
intendedPopulation: Patients with pituitary macroadenoma on coronal MRI.

options.label: Grade 0: Tumour medial to the medial tangent of the intracavernous and supraclinoid ICA
Grade 1: Tumour extends to, but not beyond, the intercarotid line
Grade 2: Tumour extends beyond the intercarotid line but not beyond the lateral tangent
Grade 3A: Extension beyond the lateral tangent into the superior cavernous sinus compartment
Grade 3B: Extension beyond the lateral tangent into the inferior cavernous sinus compartment
Grade 4: Complete encasement of the intracavernous ICA

resultStates.label: Grade 0
resultStates.summary: Tumour medial to the medial tangent of the intracavernous and supraclinoid ICA.
resultStates.detail: Surgically confirmed cavernous sinus invasion (Micko 2015): 0% surgically confirmed invasion.

resultStates.label: Grade 1
resultStates.summary: Tumour extends to, but not beyond, the intercarotid line.

resultStates.label: Grade 2
resultStates.summary: Tumour extends beyond the intercarotid line but not beyond the lateral tangent.

resultStates.label: Grade 3A
resultStates.summary: Extension beyond the lateral tangent into the superior cavernous sinus compartment.

resultStates.label: Grade 3B
resultStates.summary: Extension beyond the lateral tangent into the inferior cavernous sinus compartment.

resultStates.label: Grade 4
resultStates.summary: Complete encasement of the intracavernous ICA.

clinicalContext.text: Predicts true cavernous sinus invasion and the chance of complete resection.

clinicalInsights.text: Grades 3B and 4 have high rates of true invasion; gross total resection is less likely.

limitations.text: MRI-based; true invasion is confirmed only surgically or histologically.

limitations: Grades 2 and 3A show the most inter-rater variability.

guideSections.what: Grades 0–4 (with 3A/3B) of lateral extension relative to ICA reference lines.
guideSections.howToPerform: On coronal T1 post-contrast, draw the medial tangent, intercarotid line and lateral tangent; grade the tumour's lateral extent.

sources.citation: Knosp E, Steiner E, Kitz K, Matula C. Pituitary adenomas with invasion of the cavernous sinus space: a magnetic resonance imaging classification compared with surgical findings. Neurosurgery. 1993;33(4):610-617.

Micko ASG, Wöhrer A, Wolfsberger S, Knosp E. Invasion of the cavernous sinus space in pituitary adenomas: endoscopic verification and its correlation with an MRI-based classification. J Neurosurg. 2015;122(4):803-811.
